title: Kim Jong Un hosts Xi Jinping from a position of rare strength
snippet: Kim hosts Xi from position of rare strength. Nuclear status cemented, Russia cooperation dividends, economy rebounded from pandemic isolation. 21-gun salute, military band welcome. Xi expressed willingness to expand cooperation in trade, agriculture, construction, technology. China remains NK's most critical economic lifeline.
